deployment_function: nanosam.utils.predictor.preprocess_image(image, size=1024) (called by Predictor.set_image, the exact path the deployed and eval encoders use)
steps: aspect-aware resize: long side -> 1024, short side = 1024/aspect
dtype: float32 (calibrator feeds fp32; TRT INT8 builder quantizes internally)
forbidden: feeding raw JPEG bytes / different normalization / different resize / different pad scheme — would desync calibration distribution from deployment distribution
reuse_strategy: Stage C1 will import preprocess_image directly — no reimplementation
